description: This PHP source file handles the listing and pagination logic for the ListView component in the vtiger CRM application. It manages search, sorting, and query modifications for listing records, and displays the total number of pages based on entries per page.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Class for handling custom view selections and queries in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getViewId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the current custom view.

methods.name: getCustomViewCombo
methods.description: Generates HTML for custom view selection dropdown.

methods.name: getCustomViewByCvid
methods.description: Fetches details of a custom view by its ID.

methods.name: getModifiedCvListQuery
methods.description: Returns a modified list query based on the custom view.
